vocabulary.example: I have a cough and a fever.
The doctor gave me a prescription.
I have had this cold for three days.
vocabulary.example_ko: 저는 3일 동안 이 감기에 걸려 있어요.

vocabulary.example: I hope you get better soon.
I need to make an appointment with a doctor.
How long have you had this pain?

grammar.explanation_en: Present perfect (have/has + past participle) connects the past to now. Use 'for' with a length of time (for three days, for a week) and 'since' with a starting point (since Monday, since last year): 'I have had a fever since yesterday.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 현재완료(have/has + 과거분사)는 과거와 현재를 연결합니다. 'for'는 기간(for three days, for a week)과 함께, 'since'는 시작 시점(since Monday, since last year)과 함께 씁니다: 'I have had a fever since yesterday.'(어제부터 열이 있어요)

examples.en: I have had this cough for a week.
examples.ko: 저는 일주일 동안 이 기침을 하고 있어요.

examples.en: She has felt sick since Monday.

reading.title: A Trip to the Doctor
reading.text: I have had a bad cough for five days. It hasn't gotten better, so I made an appointment with a doctor. The doctor asked, 'How long have you had this cough?' I said, 'Since last Friday.' She gave me a prescription and told me to rest.
reading.text_ko: 저는 5일 동안 심한 기침을 하고 있어요. 나아지지 않아서 병원 예약을 잡았어요. 의사 선생님이 '이 기침이 얼마나 오래 됐어요?'라고 물으셨어요. 저는 '지난 금요일부터요'라고 답했어요. 선생님은 처방전을 주시고 쉬라고 하셨어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'I have had a bad cough for five days.'
The text says 'She gave me a prescription.'
